performance.driver: Operating income decreased by $13 million compared to the prior year, mainly due to lower gross profit and higher capacity alignment costs, partly offset by lower R,D&E, net, costs, as outlined above.

Operating Profit Operating profit for the year ended August 31, 2026 was $713.7 million (15.4% of net sales) compared with $563.9 million (13.0% of net sales) for the prior fiscal year, an increase of $149.8 million, or 26.6%. The increase in operating profit was due primarily to higher gross profit, partially offset by higher selling, distribution, and administrative (“SD&A”) expenses.

Revenue Revenue decreased 4% to $2,778 million, and 4% to $5,578, respectively, for the three and six months ended September 30, 2026 compared to the prior year period. The decrease was primarily driven by the impact of a slowed procurement environment in the prior year, which resulted in a slower start to programs in the current year, predominantly from civil customers, leading to reduced headcount and billable expenses.
Net revenues for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 increased by 9.8% compared to the prior year period principally driven by organic revenue growth of 9.6%.

performance.driver: Revenues increased by $1.1 million, or 8.4%, to $14.6 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026, from $13.5 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025. The increase in revenues was primarily due to management services revenue recognized at our Hearthstone segment, which reflects three months of operations in 2026 compared to two months in 2025, partially offset by a decrease in management services revenue at our Great Park segment during the three months ended September 30, 2026.

Operating income in our Northern region decreased $54.7 million, from $214.0 million during the nine months ended September 30, 2025 to $159.3 million during the nine months ended September 30, 2026. The decrease in operating income was primarily the result of a $48.2 million decrease in our gross margin and a $6.5 million increase in selling, general and administrative expense.

Operating Income Operating income for the three months ended September 30, 2026 increased $461.6 million to $991.7 million, and operating margin increased to 15.4% from 13.1% compared to the same period in 2025 due to factors discussed above.
